items.title: The small and big Zariski, etale, smooth, syntomic and fppf sites have enough points
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma asserts that fourteen sites attached to a scheme, the small and big Zariski, etale, smooth, syntomic and fppf sites together with their affine versions, each have enough points (statement lines 3810-3819). The proof uses the comparison of the topologies to reduce the assertion to one of the sites (proof lines 3821-3832) and then observes that the geometric points of S supply a conservative family of points for all of them, because a map of sheaves is an isomorphism exactly when it is so on all stalks at geometric points (proof lines 3832-3840). The non-formal content is the reduction through the comparisons of topologies. The claim is H2: one reduction plus one identification of points.
